messages:
priya: Quick announcement: launching a small pilot for the "data-residency-toggle" feature for Private customers starting today. Purpose: let tenants opt into temporary region-migrations for DR or analytics-only exports while keeping region_lock by default.

tom: Great. Who's in the pilot cohort?

dora: Pilot cohort = 5 enterprise tenants (security-approved). We'll expose a timed toggle (duration up to 72h) and require signed export approvals. Ops will monitor.

priya: API example for starting a timed migration window:
```bash
curl -X POST https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/321/migration-windows \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"duration_hours":24, "reason":"DR-test", "approve_signature":"base64sig"}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: migration-toggle pilot flag enabled in prod at 1782800300 :white_check_mark:

legal: Note: require export approval record and DPA addendum for pilot tenants. I'll attach the signed template and require CSM confirmation before enabling per-tenant.

csm-bot: PS-bot: Scheduling: onboarding/checklist review with pilot customers this week. Use /book-ps-pilot <customer> to reserve a slot.

priya: Action items: 1) Legal finalize addendum for pilot tenants (legal) 2) Ops monitor logs & notify on any cross-region latency >20% (tom + ops) 3) CSM confirm signed approvals before enabling toggle (csm-bot) 4) Eng to add console banner explaining timed migration window and limits (dora).

tom: We'll run a smoke test with tenant-3 at 14:00 PT and report results here.

priya: Thanks team. Pilot runs for two weeks; if stable, we'll expand to controlled rollout. Tag me for any blockers. :mag:
